<script setup lang="ts">
// <Surface3DChart>: z = f(x, y) over a regular grid (`rows`, `cols`, `z`
// row by row), lit and colored by height, with contour lines projected on
// the floor.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { Surface3DChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { name: "Ripple", height: "Height" },
  zh: { name: "波纹", height: "高度" },
  ja: { name: "波紋", height: "高さ" },
  fr: { name: "Onde", height: "Hauteur" },
};

// z = sin(r) / r over a 60 × 60 grid from -10 to 10
const N = 60;
const WAVE = {
  rows: N,
  cols: N,
  x: Array.from({ length: N }, (_, i) => -10 + (20 * i) / (N - 1)),
  y: Array.from({ length: N }, (_, i) => -10 + (20 * i) / (N - 1)),
  z: Array.from({ length: N * N }, (_, k) => {
    const x = -10 + (20 * (k % N)) / (N - 1);
    const y = -10 + (20 * Math.floor(k / N)) / (N - 1);
    const r = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1e-6;
    return Math.sin(r) / r;
  }),
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const series = computed(() => [{ name: text.value.name, data: WAVE }]);
</script>

<template>
  <Surface3DChart
    :series="series"
    :contours="{ count: 10, floor: true }"
    color-scale="viridis"
    :z-axis="{ title: text.height }"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// A terrain with a wireframe (`wireframe`, every 2nd grid line) and the
// "terrain" color scale; hover a cell to read its elevation.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { Surface3DChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { name: "Terrain", axes: ["East (km)", "North (km)", "Elevation (m)"] },
  zh: { name: "地形", axes: ["东（公里）", "北（公里）", "海拔（米）"] },
  ja: { name: "地形", axes: ["東（km）", "北（km）", "標高（m）"] },
  fr: { name: "Relief", axes: ["Est (km)", "Nord (km)", "Altitude (m)"] },
};

// two hills and a valley on a 40 × 40 grid (heights in meters)
const N = 40;
const TERRAIN = {
  rows: N,
  cols: N,
  z: Array.from({ length: N * N }, (_, k) => {
    const x = (k % N) / 4;
    const y = Math.floor(k / N) / 4;
    return Math.round(
      900 * Math.exp(-((x - 3) ** 2 + (y - 4) ** 2) / 6) +
        600 * Math.exp(-((x - 7) ** 2 + (y - 7) ** 2) / 4) -
        200 * Math.exp(-((x - 6) ** 2 + (y - 2) ** 2) / 3) +
        300,
    );
  }),
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const series = computed(() => [{ name: text.value.name, data: TERRAIN }]);
</script>

<template>
  <Surface3DChart
    :series="series"
    :wireframe="{ step: 2 }"
    color-scale="terrain"
    :x-axis="{ title: text.axes[0] }"
    :y-axis="{ title: text.axes[1] }"
    :z-axis="{ title: text.axes[2] }"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: 3D surface chart
translationResources.description: Surfaces z = f(x, y) over a regular grid: lighting, built-in color maps (viridis, plasma, terrain…), wireframe, contour lines projected on the floor and transparency. Drag to rotate, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom.

functions.title: Math functions
functions.description: sinc, MATLAB's peaks and a saddle sampled on a grid, colored by height with the default viridis ramp.

terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.description: A 180 × 180 heightmap of a fractal island with the terrain color map, a flattened box (aspect) and a stronger directional light.

volatility.title: Volatility surface
volatility.description: Implied volatility of index options by strike and time to expiry: the smile and the skew of short expiries, with a thin wireframe.

wireframe-contours.title: Wireframe and contours
wireframe-contours.description: Switch the faces, the wireframe and the contour lines (projected on the floor or drawn on the surface) of the peaks function.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Two surfaces with an opacity below 1 show where a tilted plane crosses a bowl; colorBy "series" gives each one its legend color. On WebGPU and WebGL2 transparent surfaces, bars and dots blend in any order (weighted blended order-independent transparency), so intersections stay smooth; WebGL and Canvas2D sort them back to front.

live-wave.title: Live wave
live-wave.description: Ripples recomputed about 30 times per second: a new data object each frame updates the chart. The animation stops when the demo leaves the screen or the tab is hidden.

heat-diffusion.title: Heat diffusion
heat-diffusion.description: A metal plate simulated with the heat equation: a setInterval (cleaned up on unmount) runs a few finite-difference steps and sets a new data object. onPointClick gives the row and col of the clicked vertex to add or remove a heat source; zAxis and valueRange are fixed so the inferno scale does not rescale while the plate warms up.

yield-curve.title: Yield curve over time
yield-curve.description: Two years of a government yield curve, from inverted to normal, as a maturity × month surface with contour lines on the floor. Axis format callbacks turn grid indices into maturities and Intl.DateTimeFormat months, and onHover reads the yield and the 10-year minus 2-year spread of the hovered month.

loss-landscape.title: Loss landscape
loss-landscape.description: Himmelblau's function, a test landscape with four minima, drawn as log10(1 + loss) with floor contours. The select switches colorScale between built-in ramps; click a point to run gradient descent from there and see which minimum it reaches.

wifi-signal.title: Wi-Fi coverage
wifi-signal.description: Signal strength over an office floor from log-distance path loss and wall losses, recomputed when access points are toggled with the tags. Contour levels mark the −67 and −75 dBm thresholds, and the button calls setCamera() on the ref for an orthographic top view, or resetCamera() to go back.

Surface3DChartProps.wireframe: Wireframe of the series that do not set one
Surface3DChartProps.contours: Contour lines of the series that do not set them

Surface3DSeries.colorBy: Source of the colors: the height ("z"), the value grid ("value") or the series color
Surface3DSeries.wireframe: Grid lines over the surface (true or options)
Surface3DSeries.contours: Contour lines, on the floor by default (true or options)
Surface3DSeries.fill: Draws the faces; false keeps only the wireframe and the contours

Surface3DData.rows: Number of rows (y samples), 2 or more
Surface3DData.cols: Number of columns (x samples), 2 or more
Surface3DData.z: rows × cols heights stored row by row (Float32Array recommended); NaN leaves a hole
Surface3DData.x: X coordinates of the columns; 0 … cols − 1 when omitted
Surface3DData.y: Y coordinates of the rows; 0 … rows − 1 when omitted
Surface3DData.value: rows × cols values mapped to the color scale instead of the heights

Surface3DWireframeOptions.color: Line color; a tint of the text color by default
Surface3DWireframeOptions.step: Draws every n-th grid line (at most 64 lines per direction by default)

Surface3DContourOptions.count: Number of levels spread over the height range
Surface3DContourOptions.floor: Projects the lines on the floor of the box
Surface3DContourOptions.surface: Draws the lines on the surface itself
Surface3DContourOptions.color: Line color; each level takes its color-scale color by default

Chart3DCommonProps.height: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels
Chart3DCommonProps.width: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels
Chart3DCommonProps.xAxis: X axis (width of the box): title, range, ticks, format, categories
Chart3DCommonProps.camera: Initial camera (azimuth, elevation, zoom, projection, field of view), also restored by a double click; changing it moves the camera
Chart3DCommonProps.autoRotate: Turns the camera around the box: true at 12°/s or a speed in degrees per second; pauses while hovered, off-screen and with reduced motion
Chart3DCommonProps.aspect: Proportions of the box (x, y, z)
Chart3DCommonProps.box: Draws the axis box: back walls, grid lines, tick labels and axis titles
Chart3DCommonProps.colorScale: Colors of colorBy "z" / "value": a built-in ramp (viridis, plasma, inferno, magma, cividis, turbo, spectral, coolwarm, terrain, blues) or CSS colors
Chart3DCommonProps.valueRange: Values mapped to the ends of the color scale; the data range by default
Chart3DCommonProps.colorBar: Color bar of the color scale (title, format); shown when a visible series uses the scale
Chart3DCommonProps.legend: Legend; shown when several series have a name, clicking an item toggles its series
Chart3DCommonProps.tooltip: Tooltip; false disables it, render replaces its content
Chart3DCommonProps.interaction: Drag rotates, right / Shift + drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, double click resets, arrow keys rotate; false makes the chart static
Chart3DCommonProps.lighting: Ambient, diffuse and specular light of the surfaces and bars
Chart3DCommonProps.exposure: Brightness of the light of additive series (blend "additive"), tone mapped on WebGPU and WebGL2: dense glowing regions saturate gracefully instead of turning white
Chart3DCommonProps.renderer: Backend of the data layer: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software
Chart3DCommonProps.palette: Series colors (defaults to the --chart-series-1..8 CSS variables, then the theme colors)
Chart3DCommonProps.locale: Language of the built-in texts (accessible summary, legend announcements, tooltip row names) and of the number formatting; built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French. Defaults to the page language (<html lang>), then the browser language
Chart3DCommonProps.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts of the locale (see Chart3DLabels)
Chart3DCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered point, cell or bar changes
Chart3DCommonProps.onPointClick: Called when a point, cell or bar is clicked
Chart3DCommonProps.onCameraChange: Called after the user rotated, zoomed, panned or reset the camera
Chart3DCommonProps.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once it is ready (and after a fallback)
Chart3DCommonProps.ref: Imperative handle: resetCamera, getCamera, setCamera, getRenderer, getInstance

Chart3DSeriesBase.name: Name shown in the legend and the tooltip
Chart3DSeriesBase.color: Series color (any CSS color, var(--x) included); the palette when omitted
Chart3DSeriesBase.hidden: Hides the series (it stays in the legend)
Chart3DSeriesBase.format: Formats the value (or the height) of the hovered item in the tooltip

ripple.title: A ripple with contour lines
ripple.description: z = sin(r) / r over a 60 × 60 grid, colored by height, with contour lines projected on the floor.

terrain.title: Terrain with a wireframe
terrain.description: Two hills and a valley with every second grid line drawn and the terrain color scale; hover to read elevations.

props.options: Other engine options (Chart3DOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: colors, texts, locale, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered point, cell or bar changed; detail: { seriesIndex, seriesName, type, index, x, y, z, value, color, label }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point, cell or bar was clicked; detail: { seriesIndex, seriesName, type, index, x, y, z, value, color, label }
events.minerva-camera-change: The user rotated, zoomed, panned or reset the camera; detail: { azimuth, elevation, zoom, pan, projection }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.resetCamera: Restores the camera of the options
methods.getCamera: Current camera, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
